runtime.entrypoint: JSON {id: providerJobId, input: job} on stdin; one redacted JSON result on stdout
runtime.mount: /banks read-only: <avatarSha256>.tar and <bankReceiptSha256>.json; no keys or media in image
runtime.protocol: Existing pong/start/PCM/end/lapp/done plus mandatory pong.attestation and exact bind acknowledgement
runtime.rendering: 24fps, 220ms leading and 530ms trailing silence, 12-frame chunks; one utterance/job
runtime.admission: Game server and budget journal own authorization, reservation, accepted provider job and finalization

notes: build.py never pushes or creates cloud resources.
Use a full verified prepared bank, not the shortened offline preview bank.
Measured throughput below 30fps fails admission; no MIN_RUTOR=0 override.
